name: NayaNET Smart Blocks
ground_rules: Black ground only. Never light mode, never white page backgrounds.
Text is white 99% of the time; hierarchy comes from size (24/18/14), never color.
Buttons: silver-white at rest, identity color ignites on interaction. Black heart, white voice, visible skin.
Color has three jobs: chrome (actions), text (white), theme (one spectrum accent per item). Never cross them.
Spectrum flows in law order: purple, blue, green, yellow, gold, orange, red, magenta.
Motion encodes information: breathe = alive, shimmer = light, press = physical. No decoration.
Every data instrument names what it measures. A chart that calculates nothing is a screensaver.
Copy reads like an invitation, not documentation.
Icons are drawn vector geometry, readable at 16px. No shrunk photos.
One hero CTA per page. One nav system per page. One media moment per view.
how_to_use: To BUILD a page: read RECIPES.md, pick the page recipe, pull each block by id from this manifest, paste the html, link blocks/naya-blocks.css (+ naya-blocks.js if any block has js_needed=true).
To REPAINT a page: read PAINT-JOB.md. Audit the existing page block by block, map each old pattern to the canonical block id in this manifest, swap and re-verify by screenshot.
Prefer tier=canonical. tier=alt blocks earned a 9+ as variants — use when the canonical does not fit the room. tier=new closes documented gaps. tier=specimen is anatomy reference, not for production.
Never invent a new button, card, or input. If no block fits, that is a gap to report, not a license to freestyle.
